title: Beat Number · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Beat Number · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: A partner chooses one of four beats in a simple count. The partner counts to four and claps only on the chosen beat. The lead identifies which beat carried the clap. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Beat Number, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead identifies which beat carried the clap.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The lead identifies which beat carried the clap.
